summary: The test suite is well-structured with three complementary test files (unit logic, workflow structure, integration via act) covering all major functional requirements: secret classification, report generation, multiple output formats, config loading, and error handling. Unit tests use deterministic fixtures and boundary condition testing for core logic; integration tests run the full workflow via act and verify exact outputs, which is rigorous for the happy path. Workflow structural tests validate YAML and actionlint compliance. Gaps include: CLI flag testing (-FailOnExpired), exit code validation, input validation edge cases (null fields, special characters, non-integer policies), and environment variable precedence. Design is sound but has robustness concerns: external tool dependencies (act, actionlint, custom Docker image) lack clear error handling; test result caching in act tests could mask failures; some dependencies (powershell-yaml module, fixture files) are not explicitly documented. Would catch most regressions in core functionality and workflow structure, but insufficient coverage for production secret management (input validation edge cases are significant for security-critical code).
